purpose: Primary-source R0 facts for three direct-equity T1 nominees. It records audited FY2025 and reported Q1 2026 facts plus the precise missing R1/R2 work. It is not a valuation, target-price, expected-return, investment recommendation or allocation decision.

issuers.name: 美的集团
issuers.sector_research_model: consumer appliances, building technology, robotics/automation, industrial technology and overseas operations

audit_status.fy2025: standard unqualified audit opinion reported in CE01

q1_2026_reported_financials.reported_business_detail: The Q1 report states that building technology, robotics/automation and industrial technology revenue was CNY10.8bn, CNY8.2bn and CNY6.8bn respectively, with year-on-year changes of +10.1%, +11.8% and -11.7%.

issuers.r0_interpretation: Reported Q1 attributable profit growth and the decline in profit excluding non-recurring items require a bridge before normalised earnings can be inferred. This is a diligence question, not a directional conclusion.
r1_r2_required: Three-year segment, geography, working-capital, goodwill and cash-conversion bridge.
FX, tariff, overseas demand and supply-chain sensitivity analysis.
Current-price bull/base/bear valuation and clearly dated share-count/market-cap packet.
Governance, related-party, post-Q1 announcement, float, liquidity, suspension and price-limit review.
Broker/Street record or explicit evidence that no usable record exists; catalysts and invalidation conditions.

issuers.name: 长江电力
issuers.sector_research_model: hydrology, generation, dispatch, power pricing, operating assets, capital expenditure and balance-sheet management

audit_status.fy2025: standard unqualified audit opinion reported in CE03

issuers.r0_interpretation: The gap between Q1 reported and profit-excluding-nonrecurring growth must be reconciled, including disclosed fair-value items, before any earnings run-rate conclusion. Hydrology and tariff drivers must be modelled explicitly rather than replaced by a historical cash-flow label.
r1_r2_required: Capacity, capital expenditure, debt, acquisition, related-party and dispatch analysis.
Current-price valuation with a sector-appropriate normalised earnings framework.
Policy, tariff, operational outage, governance and post-Q1 announcement review.
Current float/liquidity/market-status packet, broker/Street record, catalysts and invalidation conditions.

issuers.name: 招商银行
issuers.sector_research_model: net-interest margin, credit quality, provision coverage, capital, fee income, retail and wholesale banking

audit_status.fy2025: CE05 states that the PRC Accounting Standards and IFRS annual financial statements received standard auditing reports with unqualified opinions.
audit_status.limitation: CE05 is the H-share English report and says the Chinese version prevails in the event of a discrepancy; the A-share Chinese filing remains a required cross-check.

issuers.r0_interpretation: The bank must be modelled through PB-ROTE-cost-of-equity and NIM-credit-provision-capital mechanics; industrial-company revenue/FCF shortcuts are not a valid valuation method. Reported stable asset-quality ratios do not remove the need for granular property, retail-credit and capital stress analysis.
r1_r2_required: Reconcile the A-share Chinese filing with the captured H-share report and collect post-Q1 disclosures.
Build a PB-ROTE-cost-of-equity valuation with NIM, credit-cost, provisions, capital and fee-income sensitivities.
Review property and retail-credit exposures, related parties, regulatory changes and concentration risks.
Capture current price, share count, market capitalisation, float, ADTV, price-limit/suspension status and account access.
Obtain broker/Street record or document absence; state catalysts, invalidation and portfolio common-risk contribution.

portfolio_boundary.reason: R0 facts alone cannot set a weight. No current valuation, cost/tax, total-return, risk-budget, overlap, suitability or execution packet has passed.

warnings: Reported financial results are historical filing facts, not forecasts or expected returns.
No current price, target price, fair value, price objective, market-cap snapshot, broker consensus or live liquidity conclusion is supplied.
No dividend, distribution or cash-receipt threshold is used in nomination or evaluation.
No automatic reinvestment, forced allocation or order instruction is used.
